testcase.name: SSE displays a delta before the final result and preserves new action metadata
arbitrary UTF-8 byte boundaries preserve Vietnamese, emoji, Markdown and SSE CRLF frames
structured action validation errors and broken streams never appear as success
real chunk queue preserves every character while displaying small groups
aborting a response discards its queue and cannot overwrite the next response
cancel during unmount resolves queue completion and ignores future chunks
